import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def longest_substring_with_k_unique(s, k):
    if not s or k <= 0:
        return -1
    
    n = len(s)
    if k > n:
        return -1
    
    # Check if we have at least k unique characters
    unique_chars = set(s)
    if len(unique_chars) < k:
        return -1
    
    left = 0
    max_len = 0
    char_count = defaultdict(int)
    unique_count = 0
    
    for right in range(n):
        # Add current character to the window
        char_count[s[right]] += 1
        if char_count[s[right]] == 1:
            unique_count += 1
        
        # Shrink the window if we have more than k unique characters
        while unique_count > k:
            char_count[s[left]] -= 1
            if char_count[s[left]] == 0:
                unique_count -= 1
            left += 1
        
        # Update max length if we have exactly k unique characters
        if unique_count == k:
            current_len = right - left + 1
            if current_len > max_len:
                max_len = current_len
    
    return max_len if max_len > 0 else -1

def main():
    # Read input
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not s:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    k_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    k = int(k_line) if k_line else 0
    
    result = longest_substring_with_k_unique(s, k)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
